parameters.name: DataKeyName
parameters.description: The name of the managed data key (DK) to query. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
